candidate_evidence.quote: This global clinical trial which evaluates the efficacy and safety of TLX101-Tx, an investigational radiopharmaceutical therapy, in combination with lomustine versus lomustine alone in adult patients with first recurrence of glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Radiographic evidence of first recurrence or progressive glioblastoma according to RANO 2.0 criteria

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: We will measure how much radiation from TLX101-Tx reaches the tumor and the bone marrow. This is done using special imaging scans (called SPECT, CT, and MRI) that help us see where the treatment goes in the body.

role_evidence.quote: TLX101-Tx, an investigational radiopharmaceutical therapy, in combination with lomustine versus lomustine alone

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: TLX101-Tx delivers targeted radiation to glioblastoma cells.

agents.drug_class_hint: nitrosourea alkylating agent, standard of care at recurrence

role_evidence.quote: Specifically, amino acid-based molecular imaging using \[18F\]FET PET will be evaluated following co-registration with MRI.

agents.drug_class_hint: amino acid PET tracer (18F) used for eligibility imaging

source_quote.quote: Previously confirmed neuropathological diagnosis of glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype according to the WHO 2021 classification.

coder_notes: Title/summary describe TLX101-Tx + lomustine versus lomustine alone, but the registered arms are TLX101-Tx + lomustine and TLX101-Tx only (both EXPERIMENTAL, non-randomised per design); no lomustine-alone arm is registered, so control_arm_from_other_arms coded no. Lomustine is standard of care in one arm only; coded soc_backbone (described as SoC, not the investigational question). Regimen coded combination because the main arm combines lomustine; the TLX101-Tx-only arm is monotherapy. Eligibility requires increased [18F]FET PET uptake (an imaging, LAT-1-related selection criterion); imaging-only markers are not molecular biomarkers per manual section 5, so not recorded as a biomarker, but an adjudicator may consider it a target-related selection for the LAT-1 targeted candidate. The FET tracer is not a registered intervention but is required for every patient at screening; listed as diagnostic_agent. Tumour dosimetry by SPECT treated as tumour PK of the candidate. Active moiety iodofalan with 131I isotope per W1.
